summary: AstraZeneca PLC filed a Form 6-K with the SEC to notify the admission of 14,784 additional ordinary shares (ISIN: GB0009895292) to trading on the London Stock Exchange's Main Market, issued under its employee share schemes between 1 June 2026 and 30 June 2026 and covered by a block admission dated 29 January 2021. The new shares are fully fungible with existing shares, bringing total outstanding to 1,551,024,534. No prospectus, price, premium, or strategic event is involved. This is a routine capital maintenance disclosure under UK POATRs, not a special situation.
